# self-update: support softwareupdate

Add a target that installs macOS updates — Apple's `softwareupdate --install --all` (with `--restart` where needed) — so that `self-update all` covers the operating system as well as Homebrew, the Go tools, Docker images and Oh My Zsh. **Motivation:** "update macOS software too."
